purpose: Define the only persisted representation of provider headers allowed for v2 replay.

secret_injection.source: runtime auth file or environment supplied to the provider adapter

profile_requirements: Derived from the request headers of a successful new v2 provider capture
Contains normalized lowercase header names and only non-secret values
Records capture digest, provider endpoint origin, model id, and capture success status
Uses a literal runtime-secret placeholder for required secret-bearing headers without recording their values
Fails closed on any header outside the allowlist or any credential-like persisted value
